about: Without mod cells nothing changes: an empty small slot's menu keeps its three vanilla entries (no CUSTOM), and the CUSTOM build list stays empty. A fresh game with no mods, vanilla WALL 1 unlocked through the debug tool action.

steps.why: a vanilla small cell, so the SMALL list exists
NEW > SMALL builds an empty small slot
control: the slot menu is open
no mod cell fits: no CUSTOM entry
